items.area: R1 — J08 declarative trial on KubeCoder
items.description: `KubeCoder/Jenkinsfile` (Build-Main) is converted to declarative: `agent { kubernetes { yaml … } }` built from the library's pod-YAML helper — per ruling F1 a standalone `podYaml`, called as `podYaml templates: […], images: […]`, not `containerTemplates.podYaml(...)` — with `yamlMergeStrategy merge()` so the inherited `kaniko` template's YAML survives (ruling F2), and `options{}`/`triggers{}` for its job config. The file must pass the full linter check (POST `/pipeline-model-converter/validate` on the controller). The conversion is faithful (ruling D3): the converted file gets no `when{}` and no `post{}`, because the scripted file has no conditional stage and no failure or cleanup handling.
items.rationale: Converted Jenkinsfile (KubeCoder 30df8e2d): declarative agent kubernetes with inheritFrom, yamlMergeStrategy merge(), yaml podYaml(...), options/triggers, no when/post/try/catch; 16 stages before and after. POST /pipeline-model-converter/validate → "Jenkinsfile successfully validated." (2026-09-30).
evidence: KubeCoder/Jenkinsfile:7 — today's job config is scripted `properties([disableConcurrentBuilds(abortPrevious: true), pipelineTriggers([githubPush()])])` (KubeCoder HEAD 5bbf14bf)

KubeCoder/Jenkinsfile:9-30 — today's pod is `podTemplate(inheritFrom: 'jenkins-agent kaniko', containers: [...])` with `containerTemplates.k8s`, `containerTemplates.modern_app_toolchain` and inline `golang`/`node`
KubeCoder/Jenkinsfile:31-340 — every stage runs on every build: no `if`, `try`, `catch`, `finally`, `catchError` or `warnError` outside comments (grep, KubeCoder HEAD 5bbf14bf, 2026-09-30)

items.area: R1 — J08 declarative trial on KubeCoder
items.description: The converted build changes syntax, not what it does: the Replay's pod, as the `kubernetes` plugin prints it at the top of the console, matches a scripted Build-Main build's (containers, images, pull policies, users, resources, the inherited `kaniko` container, `busybox-share-init` init container and volumes), except for what ruling F1 brings — `node` pulls `Always`, and `golang` and `node` are kept alive by `sleep infinity` rather than `cat` with a tty — and the same stages run in the same order, ending in the KubeCoderDeploy pin write.
items.rationale: #559's printed pod matches #558's per container: jnlp, kaniko, k8s, modern-app-toolchain, golang, node and the busybox-share-init init container, with the same images, users, resources and pod-level spec. The only differences are ruling F1's (node imagePullPolicy IfNotPresent -> Always; golang and node run sleep infinity instead of cat with tty) and default-valued fields #558 printed and #559 leaves out (resources: {}, tty: false, privileged: false). The 16 stages ran in the same order, ending in the KubeCoderDeploy pin write.
evidence: $JENKINS_URL/job/KubeCoder/job/Build-Main/558/consoleText — a scripted build (SUCCESS) whose printed pod spec holds jnlp, kaniko, k8s, modern-app-toolchain, golang, node, the busybox-share-init init container, nodeSelector and the busybox/workspace-volume emptyDirs (read 2026-09-30)

items.description: The library's `podYaml` helper is on JenkinsPipelineUtils' main, in a file of its own (ruling F1): `podYaml templates: […], images: […]` returns one pod spec a declarative Kubernetes agent takes, holding the library's `k8s` and `modern-app-toolchain` sidecars with the settings their `containerTemplates` describables carry, plus any container the pipeline names by image — a string, or a map overriding name, resources, `runAsUser` and env — kept alive and pulled `Always` like the sidecars, with no library change. `containerTemplates.*` is untouched. The helper is `@NonCPS` string building, and `kc project test` asserts its output in full.
items.rationale: vars/podYaml.groovy on JenkinsPipelineUtils main (pushed caf6b75), @NonCPS, templates/images args; containerTemplates untouched; PodYamlTest (6 tests) green in the sweep root test.
evidence: JenkinsPipelineUtils/vars/containerTemplates.groovy:19-21,62-64 — `k8s` (`registry:5000/k8s:1.35.5`) and `modern_app_toolchain` (`registry:5000/kube-coder-modern-app-toolchain:node-24`, `runAsUser: '1000'`) return `containerTemplate(...)` describables kept alive by `sleep infinity` with `alwaysPullImage: true`, which an `agent` block cannot take (library HEAD 276beff)

KubeCoder/Jenkinsfile:25-29 — `golang` (`registry:5000/kube-coder-go-toolchain:latest`, CPU 2/4, memory 2Gi/4Gi) and `node` (`node:24-bookworm`) are the pipeline's own containers, which `images:` carries (KubeCoder HEAD 5bbf14bf)
